messages:
sara_pm: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem: https://redwood-internal/postmortems/1801234000-fallback-loop. I consolidated the remediation items below. Please claim ownership + add a JIRA and RACI. Reply in the format: owner / JIRA / RACI (R/A/C/I) / due (YYYY-MM-DD).

sara_pm: Remediation list:
A) Fix selector race causing fallback loops (root: concurrent model selector + cold cache)
B) Canary pipeline that exercises KV cache warmup patterns
C) Incident playbook: latency spike + model-fallback mitigation steps
D) Billing guardrail: detect unexpected fallback-driven cost spikes
E) CI e2e perf smoke after deploy (short token profile)
F) Investigation: frequency analysis of selector races across last 90 days

amelia_eng: I'll take A. owner: amelia_eng / JIRA: RI-2501 / RACI: R=amelia_eng A=sara_pm C=liz_runtime,marcus_sre I=eng-all / due: 2026-05-04

raj_infra: I'll own B. owner: raj_infra / JIRA: RI-2502 / RACI: R=raj_infra A=eng-infra C=amelia_eng I=platform-team / due: 2026-05-12

marcus_sre: Picking up C. owner: marcus_sre / JIRA: RI-2503 / RACI: R=marcus_sre A=eng-sre C=oncall,liz_runtime I=eng-all / due: 2026-04-30

liz_runtime: I'll split D+E: D) billing telemetry hookup owner: liz_runtime / JIRA: RI-2504 / RACI: R=liz_runtime A=finance C=marcus_sre I=product / due: 2026-05-07; E) CI e2e owner: liz_runtime / JIRA: RI-2505 / RACI: R=liz_runtime A=ci-team C=amelia_eng I=eng-oncall / due: 2026-05-01

marcus_sre: For C, I'll draft the playbook and link mitigation snippets (pin variant, scale up pool, disable rollout). Will add initial draft to RI-2503 this week.

amelia_eng: For A, I'll add a unit/regression test that reproduces the selector race and a short harness in RI-2501. Also proposing a deployment gating rule: delay rollout unless KV hit rate > X for 5 min.

raj_infra: For B, plan: canary job replays representative traffic to warm caches; estimate cost ~3 GPU-hours per run. @sara_pm please confirm budget for biweekly run for pilot.

sara_pm: Budget approved for biweekly pilot for two months. Start biweekly and we can adjust after metrics.

ops-bot: Reminder created: "Postmortem Remediation Sync" recurring weekly starting 2026-04-01 14:00 UTC. Owners pinged: amelia_eng, raj_infra, marcus_sre, liz_runtime.

marcus_sre: F (investigation) I'll own as well: owner: marcus_sre / JIRA: RI-2506 / RACI: R=marcus_sre A=eng-sre C=eng-runtime I=product / due: 2026-05-06. Plan: run log analysis + sampling of rollout windows to measure frequency and traffic correlation.

amelia_eng: If F shows recurring pattern, we should add 'safe-rollout' gating into the orchestrator. I'll coordinate with raj on gating thresholds.

raj_infra: Note on handoffs: if platform needs to take B after initial infra prototype, I'll add checklist and assign to platform-lead in RI-2502.

liz_runtime: I'll ensure RI-2505 includes a lightweight perf smoke (200 tokens, cached vs cold) and that CI marks regressions as blockers.

sara_pm: Recap: A=amelia_eng (RI-2501), B=raj_infra (RI-2502), C=marcus_sre (RI-2503), D=liz_runtime (RI-2504), E=liz_runtime (RI-2505), F=marcus_sre (RI-2506). Everyone: add acceptance criteria and test plans in the JIRA ticket. ops-bot will nudge 48h before due dates.

sara_pm: If you need to hand off an item, post here and tag the new owner so I can update the RACI and the recurring sync invite.

marcus_sre: tagging a possible handoff on F if the investigation needs deeper infra logs; will flag in RI-2506.

amelia_eng: added a link to my branch reproducer in RI-2501.

raj_infra: created initial pipeline stub in RI-2502, requesting review from liz_runtime.

ops-bot: Note: weekly sync invite updated with agenda: status updates for RI-2501..RI-2506, blockers, next steps.

sara_pm: Thanks all 44d. Closing thread; will reopen if there are status changes.
